ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white diced chunks, about 1.5-2 cm pieces, moist and slightly fibrous with a smooth surface, cut into irregular cubes, scattered across the center and right of the plate over greens | 95
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black roasted vegetable pieces, about 2-3 cm irregular wedges with charred, glossy skin and softened pale flesh showing at cut edges, clustered on the left side of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown walnut pieces, roughly 1 cm irregular halves and chunks, dry and crumbly with a slightly rough, bumpy surface, scattered across the salad | 25
ITEM 4 | Fresh dark green arugula-type leaves, flat and ruffled, some torn, with bright green color and slight moisture, spread across the lower center and right of the plate under other ingredients | 30
ITEM 5 | Flat golden-orange baked piece with browned, slightly charred edges and a glossy, moist sheen, topped with thin pinkish-red slices, sitting on the right edge of the plate, about 7 x 5 cm and about 1 cm thick | 85
ITEM 6 | Small red pepper pieces, about 1 cm, glossy bright red with soft, slightly wrinkled skin, mixed among the dark roasted vegetable pieces on the left | 8
ITEM 7 | Thin dark oily residue and light droplets, sheen on the plate edge near the lower left and small crumbs of walnut, minimal amount | 3
